home.faq.title: FAQ
home.faq.q1: Can I try before I buy?
home.faq.a1: Yes. Sign in free, finish onboarding, and explore reading and vocabulary before you subscribe.
home.faq.q2: How does the level check work?
home.faq.a2: You pick the language you know and the language you want to learn. Instructions use your language; the questions test the language you’re learning.
home.faq.q3: How accurate is the AI examiner?
home.faq.a3: It uses exam-style band rubrics for each criterion. It won’t replace an official human examiner, but it’s built for consistent practice feedback.
home.faq.q4: Do I pay for interface languages?
home.faq.a4: No. UI language is free in all 29. You only pay for learning languages — the subjects you study or assign.
home.faq.a5: Payments go through ATMOS (Uzcard, Humo, Visa/Mastercard). Cancel anytime.
